punchline: When Cassius's head was brought to Marcus Aurelius, the emperor refused to look at it.
thirty_sec: In 175 Avidius Cassius claimed the Roman throne after a false rumour that Marcus Aurelius had died. According to Cassius Dio, Marcus told his troops he hoped to forgive his friend, and feared Cassius would die before he could. When soldiers brought him Cassius's head, he could not look at it and had it buried. He later asked the senate that no senator be executed during his reign.
